data.body:
[P2] Preserve dropped-operation totals across both truncation passes

`DurableExecutionTelemetry.exportRecord` already truncates against `render` before calling this exporter. The new second pass invokes a helper that starts its dropped-operation counter at zero and overwrites `droppedOperations` in its output. Consequently, when the first pass drops N operations and envelope fitting drops M more, the published record reports M instead of N+M, understating missing work. Either truncate once against the envelope or make repeated truncation accumulate the existing count. Add a regression where both passes remove whole operations.
